body:
Real, client-side instant filter (#quick-filter input + applyFilter()) over every loaded kanban card (Inbox + Backlog/Priority/Cruise columns), matching title/id text as-you-type. Title matches sort ahead of id-only matches within a column while filtering, per the card's own 'name priority over the rest of the text' wording; no server round-trip, no change to drag/sort or real kanbanOrder when filter is empty. go build/vet clean, existing -run Kanban suite clean. Commit 061586d.

⚓ ☃
title: IDUXN-003: kanban board quick filter shipped
